title: Chapter 1450 - 3: One Hundred Thousand Years

Chapter 1450 - 3: One Hundred Thousand Years

Chapter 1450 - 3: One Hundred Thousand Years

The blurred figure is the remnant left by the Returning Ruins Lord in the past. Madness is only its surface; essentially, it is to leave a piece of information, or rather, a message.

"Don't go! Absolutely don't go!!!"

Even though they were separated by different times and spaces and not facing the Returning Ruins Lord himself, Lin Yuan still felt the other's intense resentment and grievance.

"The key part has been erased again."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

He completely understood the warning left by the Returning Ruins Lord's remnant.

The last three thousand tribulations in the third stage of the endless calamities, consisting of three hundred thirty million tribulations, were very likely meant to prevent someone from ascending a path of transcendence.

But who is this existence?

And which time-space and during which time period?

It remains unknown.

Without these two premises, the significance of this information is actually not very great.

Because there's simply no way to prevent it.

One can't just abandon the 'endless calamities' path of transcendence because of this warning, right?

Besides, apart from the 'endless calamities' path of transcendence, the other two paths of transcendence are also not easy to traverse, filled with hidden dangers everywhere.

"It seems to be the handiwork of the Supreme Rule Dao again."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, convinced that the Returning Ruins Lord's remnant would not deliberately erase crucial information.

Even under extreme obsession, the Returning Ruins Lord's remnant would only reveal crucial information, at the very least, those core words.

But now, there is none.

And this forceful erasure method, Lin Yuan had already seen more than once.

The last time was in the 'Abyss of Calamity' left by Lord Wanwei.

Deepest part of Wanwei time-space.

In front of the Abyss of Calamity, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

Observing the various calamities recorded within the Abyss of Calamity.

Some were experienced by Lord Wanwei, and others by different lords.

On the 'endless calamities' path of transcendence, the Returning Ruins Lord far surpassed Lord Wanwei.

The former had already passed through the last stage of three hundred and thirty million tribulations, needing only two thousand more to complete this path of transcendence.

While Lord Wanwei had only passed through the two hundred millionth tribulation of the last stage.

The last tribulation of the Abyss of Calamity was the final tribulation passed by Lord Wanwei himself.

Images flickered, finally settling on the tall figure of Lord Wanwei.

Lord Wanwei's skin appeared silvery white, like layered time-space, he clasped his hands behind his back, muttering: "My two hundred millionth tribulation was to travel to a distant future time-space to kill a being. I paid a terrible price, but I finally succeeded."

"Just that when I returned to the present time-space from that future time-space, I mistakenly entered a chaotic time-space, in that space..." The next words of Lord Wanwei were erased.

At the end of the scene was a bitter smile from Lord Wanwei: "I never thought, my Wanwei would have a day like an ant seeing the sky!"

...

Lin Yuan had watched many times; it was after passing the two hundred millionth tribulation that Lord Wanwei chose to pursue the

Perfect Time Being.

"What on earth did the will of the Supreme Rule Dao erase? Is there any connection between what Lord Wanwei and the Returning Ruins

Lord went through?"

Lin Yuan was quite curious.

Setting aside the Returning Ruins Lord, to make such a strong being as Lord Wanwei have a fractured mind and voluntarily abandon the selected path of transcendence, it wasn't simply due to strength

alone.

But rather seeing no hope at all.

If it were due to encountering a stronger being? It wouldn't have

pushed Lord Wanwei to make such a decision.

"However, all of this is still far from me."

Lin Yuan thought silently.

He was just beginning to embark on the 'endless calamities' path of

transcendence, not to mention the three hundred and thirty million tribulations of the third stage, even the first stage was uncertain how

many epochs it would take to cross.

Speculating the affairs of Lord Wanwei and the Returning Ruins Lord, is still too early.

...

Outside the Gold Moon Dimension.

After assembling the remnant of the Returning Ruins Lord and

delivering the intended message, it quickly dissipated.

In fact, the Returning Ruins Lord left this remnant solely to convey

the intended message, with no other purpose. The reason the Dragon

Stone Lord was affected to the point of losing self-control. Was completely because he was too weak and couldn't bear the

message the Returning Ruins Lord wanted to transmit.

Along with the dissipation of the remnant.

The Dragon Stone Lord gradually awoke from slumber.

"I..."

The Dragon Stone Lord felt unprecedentedly light and the usual chaos within his mind and will was no longer present, as though a divine mountain off his shoulders was removed.

"The pollution from the Returning Ruins Lord's remnant is gone?"

The Dragon Stone Lord was overjoyed and immediately bowed to Lin Yuan: "Thank you, Lord Galaxy"

The Dragon Stone Lord sincerely thanked Lin Yuan, even though He had paid with a top-level dimension space and all his possessions, the

Sand of Time.

But all of these were far less than his own self.

"Don't celebrate too early"

Lin Yuan waved his hand, "I have only eradicated the remnant

pollution in your physical soul and deep in your mind for now,

whether it has been completely eradicated and whether there are residuals in your mind cannot be assured."

Involving such terrifying beings as the Returning Ruins Lord, even just

a remnant can't be underestimated.

Especially since the Dragon Stone Lord's own strength was not strong,

he had no resistance against the remnant, possibly having it parasitize his mind without even knowing.

However, even if there were any hidden dangers, without the support of the main remnant, the remaining impact on the Dragon Stone Lord would be much smaller.

Moreover, based on Lin Yuan's previous eradication efforts, the majority of the Returning Ruins Lord's remnants were likely already locked away.
